_comment: Single source of truth for the Models catalog. Add / update / remove a model by editing its provider's `models` array. Add a provider by appending an object (give it a colorVar pair + glyph). `speed` and `tier` drive the Speed and Depth meters. `rec` maps each task to the id of the model to highlight as the top pick.

depthRule._comment: Depth = complex/multi-step task handling. Derived from tier, so it stays in sync automatically.
